scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All hard gates pass and mask-only review shows coherent moderate immune enrichment across the authorized stroma interfaces. Candidate 01 has more source-like spacing, clustering and total instance count than the other passing candidate.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 43,644-pixel tissue change is distributed across authorized stroma-to-immune interface regions while preserving intervening tumor and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: One hundred class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Candidate 01 has source-relative instance-count 1.329, NND 0.864 and Ripley K24 1.745, preferable to candidate 02 under the same quota.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei occupy the authorized changed tissue and interface transitions; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass, with sampling score 0.892.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged, without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is denser and more clustered than the source, although within the frozen hard research envelope. This patient is not four-target eligible because U1 Significant abstained. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff for this target only.

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 01 better preserves source-like nearest-neighbor spacing, clustering and total instance count and has a higher mature sampling score with the same tissue geometry and quota.
